channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: Vermont's law enforcement dispatch system was taken offline Monday night due to a potential security incident. The system manages records and dispatches for police across the state. Officials have not yet shared details on when it will be restored.

Kathryn Frizzel, a mental health caseworker, was attacked outside the Chittenden County Courthouse in Burlington. The attacker, Refga Laku, faces attempted murder charges but is deemed mentally incompetent to stand trial. Officials say Vermont needs better facilities to treat violent individuals like Laku.

Vermont's latest education report shows slight gains in student proficiency. English language arts proficiency is fifty-six percent, math forty-two percent, and science forty-five percent. Achievement gaps persist for students with disabilities and economically disadvantaged students.

Killington has lost three town employees amid workplace conflicts. Longtime bookkeeper Mona Hickory resigned citing a toxic environment and alleged harassment. Police Sgt. Mike Hoffman and Road Foreman Chad Galiano also resigned, and the town is searching for replacements.
